title: Inventory Management (Admin Only, Framework-Free)
instructions: The original Django task is rebuilt on an in-memory `Store` (see `ecom/store.py`, read-only). Implement `InventoryServiceImpl` in `ecom/services/inventory_service_impl.py` (admin-only `create_or_update_inventory`, which replaces the quantity, and `delete_inventory`, which tolerates a missing row) and `InventoryController` in `ecom/controllers/inventory_controller.py`, which never raises and reports `SUCCESS` or `FAILURE`. Raise `UserNotFoundError`, `UnauthorizedAccessError` and `ProductNotFoundError` as the requirements say.

evidence.label: An admin creates an inventory row for a product
An update sets the quantity (not adds) and keeps one row per product
Unknown user, non-admin and unknown product raise the matching errors and change nothing
An admin deletes a product inventory row
Deleting a missing row is fine, but unknown users and non-admins are rejected
The create/update controller returns SUCCESS with the inventory, or FAILURE without raising
The delete controller returns SUCCESS or FAILURE without raising
